remainingOwnerAction: Create the FREE Render web service (Blueprint from render.yaml) and a dedicated Aiven MySQL Free database in your own dashboards, paste the MySQL credentials into Render only, then add the repository variable CELIA_LIVE_URL plus the secrets RENDER_API_KEY + RENDER_SERVICE_ID (or RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL). From then on .github/workflows/deploy-render.yml deploys after every green CI run on main, runs `npm run verify:live -- --url $CELIA_LIVE_URL --expect-commit <sha>`, uploads the token-free report, and keeps the instance awake via cron-job.org; manual §5 items still need a session record. Never paste credentials or payment information into chat.

automationAfterOwnerAccounts.untilConfigured: every run ends green with a not-configured notice naming the missing inputs; no deployment is claimed

serviceRetirementsNote: Explicit, reversible retirements of services whose credentials are proven dead (DEC-030). Same flags as CELIA_DISABLE_<SERVICE>; a non-empty environment value wins over this file. Honoured by scripts/service-reality.mjs (verdict disabled), scripts/deploy-cloudflare-edge.mjs (Worker plain_text bindings) and render.yaml.

ai_gateway.reason: Vercel AI Gateway answers 403 'requires a valid credit card on file' for every completion while the key itself lists 498 models; the project forbids payment cards, so the service can never work here
ai_gateway.reversal: delete this entry once the owner adds a card to the Vercel team (not recommended under the no-card constraint)

cloudflare_r2.reason: SigV4-signed ListBuckets never reaches R2: the TLS handshake is refused for <account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, the pattern of an account on which R2 was never enabled (no bucket) or whose keys belong elsewhere; nothing in the code reads or writes R2
cloudflare_r2.reversal: enable R2 in the Cloudflare dashboard, create a bucket, re-issue the three CLOUDFLARE_R2_* secrets, delete this entry, push a [reality] commit

deepseek.reason: DeepSeek answers 402 'Insufficient Balance' (key valid); the account has no credit and the project adds none
deepseek.reversal: top up the DeepSeek account, optionally set DEEPSEEK_MODEL (the live /models lists deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro), delete this entry, push a [reality] commit

agentrouter.reason: AgentRouter accepts the key but exposes 0 models and returns an empty 200 body for chat completions: an account without quota or model access
agentrouter.reversal: restore quota/models on agentrouter.org, set AGENTROUTER_MODEL to a listed model, delete this entry, push a [reality] commit
